subject: Nonstandard sign-on & equity escalation for Senior Inference Engineer (Alex Rivera)
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma@talentloop.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate Alex Rivera — competing offer; asks for sign-on + equity refresh

Connor — quick heads up: Alex (Senior Inference Engineer candidate) accepted our verbal total package but came back with a counter from a second-runner that includes a $45k sign-on and a larger refresh than we offered. He’s leaning toward us on culture and product, but the other offer has a faster start and a cleaner sign-on.

Attached: his latest resume and our comp analysis for reference. Emma from TalentLoop here — asking if Redwood can move on an out-of-band sign-on and a modest equity refresh to lock him. Candidate is asking for: $45,000 sign-on (one-time), and +0.18% refresh on top of the current offer (0.35% total).

We need a decision today to preserve momentum; his window closes EOD PT.

Candidate note (from Alex): “Love Redwood’s mission — excited about the stack. I do have a hard counter from another company and they want an answer by Monday morning.”

Thanks — Emma

Attachments: alex_rivera_resume.pdf, comp_analysis_2026Q4.xlsx
From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Candidate Alex Rivera — competing offer; asks for sign-on + equity refresh

Team — looping you in for an expedited approval. Background: Alex is a strong hire for inference infra (1.2-1.5x impact projection over 12 months). We budgeted a standard senior package: base $185k, bonus 10%, equity 0.17%, sign-on $10k. Candidate is asking for the redlined numbers below.

Requested (candidate): sign-on $45,000; equity refresh additional 0.18% (bringing to 0.35% total); slight above-band base (+8%).

Ask: Can I get an approved out-of-band sign-on and equity refresh to match his window? If full request is too large, what’s the max we can commit to today so we don’t lose him? I’ve filled the quick approval form and attached it (approval_form_connor.pdf).

Immediate constraints: candidate can’t extend timeline beyond EOD PT. If we approve partial (sign-on only), we should offer an accelerated refresh at 6-month review.

Next steps I propose: 1) Approve sign-on up to $30k now and escalate equity to finance for review, OR 2) Approve full package (fastest close). Please advise.

— Connor O’Brien
Sr. Hiring Manager, Inference
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Candidate Alex Rivera — competing offer; asks for sign-on + equity refresh

Connor — thanks for the clear ask and the write-up. I’m inclined to support a faster close here given the candidate fit and pipeline risk, but we need to balance against comp guardrails.

Approved immediately (delegate): sign-on up to $30,000 one-time. I’ll approve a 0.10% equity refresh as an immediate addendum to the offer (brings total to 0.27%).

Outstanding: the additional $15k sign-on (to reach $45k) and the remaining 0.08% equity will require finance sign-off due to band exceptions. Rishi, can you confirm whether there’s headroom in the Q4 hiring reserve or whether we can flex the sign-on budget on a per-hire basis? If yes, Connor will proceed with the full numbers; if not, we’ll present the approved partial and offer a 6-month performance-linked refresh for the balance.

Connor — please prepare the revised offer with: base unchanged, sign-on $30k, equity +0.10% now, and a clause for potential additional refresh pending finance approval. Use the attached approval_form_connor.pdf for records.

— Laura Bennett
VP, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference
From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: connor_obrien@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, emma@talentloop.com
Date: Mon, 26 Oct 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Candidate Alex Rivera — competing offer; asks for sign-on + equity refresh

Quick update — rishi confirms partial flexibility: finance can cover an extra $10k from the hiring reserve if the hiring manager signs off to reallocate from an open contractor line (we can show the delta in Q4). That means we could reach $40k sign-on with finance approval paperwork today; the remaining $5k would need exec sign-off. Equity: finance supports Laura’s 0.10% now; the final 0.08% would be considered a retention refresh and requires CPO approval per policy.

Connor — given candidate timeline, I suggest we: 1) extend the offer with the approved numbers today (sign-on $30k + 0.10% equity) and 2) simultaneously request finance to push for $40k sign-on while we get an exec sign-off for the final $5k and CPO review on the final equity tranche. That keeps the candidate warm and preserves flexibility.

Emma — please let Alex know we can send a revised formal offer today; emphasize the immediate sign-on and equity addendum and that we are continuing to work a possible additional sign-on bridge. If he needs a firm yes on the full $45k to sign, flag that explicitly. Otherwise proceed with acceptance language for the revised offer.

I’ve created the HR Jira ticket for approvals (HR-7092) and attached the filled approval form. Connor, please attach the DocuSign link when you generate the offer packet.

— Aditya Rao
Director, Engineering Recruiting
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: approval_form_connor.pdf
